rows.summary: License holders receive every later version of the program without paying again.
rows.notes: Windfall is free under GPL-3.0; this row closes when auto-update ships.

rows.summary: Splits a mixed recording into separate drum, bass, vocal and instrument tracks.
rows.notes: unverified: lowest edition. The compare table ticks Producer, but the purchase box on the same page shows it locked below Signature. Candidate basis: Demucs (MIT).

rows.summary: Records microphone, line or internal audio onto the timeline as editable clips.
rows.notes: Native mono/stereo input capture streams to WAV and creates a normal playlist clip with undo/save support. Start/stop/discard, channel selection, overflow/error rejection and ownership guards are tested with synthetic capture. Placement uses a chosen start tick; input/output latency and separate device clocks are uncompensated. Hardware capture, monitoring, count-in and multitrack takes remain. See docs/RECORDING.md.

rows.summary: Places audio files or recordings on the timeline with per-clip gain, fades and stretch settings.
rows.notes: Playlist audio clips support gain, pan, fades, reverse, tape-style pitch and independent spectral stretch/pitch. Prepared immutable audio is shared by playback/export; source files remain unchanged. Completed input takes become ordinary clips with undo/save support.

rows.summary: Offers genre-sorted starter loops that can be auditioned and dropped into a new project.
rows.notes: Needs Windfall's own CC0 loop content; FL's loops cannot be reused.

rows.summary: A rack plugin that loads the instrument and effect modules of the mobile app inside the desktop program.
rows.notes: A Windfall equivalent would be a rack of Windfall's own modules. FL 2026 added a SoundFont player and a note arpeggiator module.

rows.summary: Keeps recording audio in the background so an unplanned take can be recovered afterwards.
rows.notes: unverified: edition availability (the compare page leaves every edition cell blank). New in FL Studio 2026.

rows.summary: Builds chord progressions for a chosen key and mood and writes them into the piano roll.
rows.notes: The manual calls it the Chord Progression Tool. Not named in the plan's phase table, so placed in phase 6.

rows.summary: A built-in chat assistant that answers questions about the program and can operate some of its controls.
rows.notes: The plan's phase-6 assistant. Control of the app and plugins is marked experimental in FL 2026.

rows.summary: Removes background noise such as hiss or hum from recorded audio.
rows.notes: Candidate basis: RNNoise (BSD). In FL this lives in the audio editor's noise removal and vocal denoiser tools.

rows.summary: The library of samples, loops and presets that ships with the program.
rows.reason: Image-Line owns its bundled samples, loops and presets, so they can never be shipped. Windfall ships its own content under CC0 or a similar license.

rows.summary: A pitch-against-time grid for drawing and editing the notes of one instrument.
rows.notes: Umbrella row; sub-features are tracked as win-piano-* rows. Draw, paint, select and erase tools, clipboard, quantize, velocity and pan lane, ghost notes. The specialist tools are separate rows.

rows.summary: Routes every sound through tracks with level, pan, effects and sends.
rows.notes: Umbrella row; the basic mixer lands in phase 1 and routing, sends and effect slots in phase 2 (win-mixer-* rows). Tracks, routing, sends, effect slots, meters and delay compensation are in. Sidechain, track EQ and track presets are separate rows.

rows.summary: The timeline where patterns, audio and automation are laid out into a complete song.
rows.notes: Pattern, audio and automation clips on the playlist, with song mode.

rows.summary: Timeline clips holding a curve that moves any linked parameter over time.
rows.notes: Curves with bends and holds for volume, pan, sends, effect and instrument settings, effect mix and tempo. No LFO or step drawing modes yet.

rows.summary: Lets the time signature change at chosen points on the timeline or inside a pattern.
Records and plays notes and controller data from MIDI keyboards and other hardware.
rows.notes: Native MIDI input auditions one explicit channel with note-on/off, sustain, channel filtering and bounded queue cleanup. Note recording, controller mapping, timestamp/sample-clock alignment and physical hardware verification remain pending. See docs/MIDI-HARDWARE.md.

rows.summary: A channel that sends notes and controller messages to external MIDI hardware or to other plugins.
rows.notes: Optional single-port live-note forwarding balances retriggers/releases and clears held hardware notes on route/device changes and panic. Pattern/playlist output, controller messages, clock and a dedicated MIDI-out channel remain pending; no physical output verification is claimed. See docs/MIDI-HARDWARE.md.

rows.fl_feature: VST2, VST3, Audio Unit and CLAP support
rows.summary: Loads third-party instrument and effect plugins in the common plugin formats.
rows.notes: Windows desktop CLAP instruments/effects, isolated CLAP/VST3 scanning, parameter automation, editors and saved state are integrated. VST3 processor-return/capture foundation is tested, while production desktop additions await remaining lifecycle/event safeguards. Native macOS/Linux desktop hosting, AU and audio crash containment remain pending. The plan covers CLAP, VST3 and AU, not VST2. See docs/plugins/desktop-integration.md and docs/plugins/vst3-desktop.md.

rows.summary: A phone or tablet app that controls the program over the local network.
rows.notes: The plan's phase-6 phone remote.

rows.summary: Generates control signals from drawn envelopes triggered by notes, for automating other parameters.
Turns note pitch and velocity from the piano roll into control signals for other parameters.
Sends control-voltage signals through spare audio outputs to drive up to eight channels of modular hardware.
Lists the project's channels (samples, instruments, audio and automation) for the selected pattern.
A row of on/off steps per channel for programming drum patterns quickly.
Per-step bars for editing note, velocity, release, fine pitch, modulation and shift values.

rows.fl_feature: Channel mute, solo, pan and volume
rows.summary: A mute/solo switch and pan and volume knobs on every channel, ahead of the mixer.
Sets which mixer track each channel feeds.
rows.notes: Windfall plans automatic routing: each new channel gets its own mixer track. New channels get their own mixer track; the routing badge on each row shows and changes it.

rows.summary: Named, reusable blocks of step and note data that can be switched, cloned and split by channel.
Delays off-beat steps by an adjustable amount for a shuffled feel.
rows.notes: Global swing only; no per-channel swing mix yet.

rows.summary: Sorts channels into named groups and shows one group at a time.

rows.fl_feature: Channel button menu (clone, replace, insert, delete, rename, color)
rows.summary: Per-channel commands to duplicate, swap, insert, remove, rename and color channels.

rows.fl_feature: Fill each N steps and Advanced Fill tool
rows.summary: Fills a channel's steps at a regular spacing or from a chosen rhythm rule.
rows.notes: Fill every 2, 4 or 8 steps and shift left or right. No advanced fill tool yet.

rows.summary: Lets one channel silence another, or itself, when a new note starts.

rows.fl_feature: Channel sampler: loop points and ping-pong loop
rows.summary: Loops a sample between its loop points, forwards or back and forth.
rows.notes: Persisted forward and ping-pong loops with inspector points relative to the trimmed sample, reverse-aware bounds, fractional boundary interpolation and note release. Undo/save/load, playback/export parity and zero callback allocations are tested. No hardware audio verification; details and limits are in docs/SAMPLER-LOOPS.md.

rows.summary: Offline treatments applied to a loaded sample, such as crossfaded loops, reversing and normalizing.
Shows a thumbnail of a channel's piano roll notes in place of its step buttons.
Converts a channel's active steps into piano roll notes.

rows.fl_feature: Channel settings: envelopes, LFOs and filter
rows.summary: Envelopes and LFOs for volume, pan, pitch and two modulation targets, plus a filter, on sampler channels.
rows.notes: Volume envelope on the sampler only.

rows.summary: A real-time, non-destructive arpeggio applied to the notes a channel receives.
Repeats a channel's notes as fading, optionally pitch-shifted echoes at the note level instead of as audio.
Caps the number of voices a channel plays and sets its glide time.

rows.fl_feature: Channel settings: gate, shift and swing mix
rows.summary: Truncates notes to a set length, offsets their start and scales how much swing applies to the channel.

rows.fl_feature: Channel sampler: time-stretch and pitch modes
rows.summary: Stretches or repitches a sample to fit the tempo, with a choice of algorithms.
rows.notes: windfall-stretch implements independent time/pitch controls, three quality presets, approximate formant preservation and tempo fitting. Synthetic quality, allocation and throughput checks pass; sampler integration remains. Sampler loops still use tape-style pitch resampling. A bounded policy for prepared note-key variants and loop/release boundaries is needed; see docs/SAMPLER-LOOPS.md and crates/windfall-stretch/VALIDATION.md.

rows.summary: A silent channel that passes its notes to several child channels so they play together.
rows.notes: Listed in the manual's plugin index, not on the compare page. The manual points to the modular rack as the more flexible alternative.

rows.summary: Adds single notes and drags them to position and length.

rows.fl_feature: Piano roll: Paint tool and drum sequencer mode
rows.summary: Adds a run of notes while dragging; a drum mode toggles steps on and off.
rows.notes: Paint tool is in. No drum sequencer mode yet.

rows.summary: Removes notes by clicking or dragging over them.
Silences notes without removing them.
Cuts notes in two along a drawn line.
Selects notes by rectangle for group edits.
Zooms the view to a dragged region.
Auditions notes by clicking or dragging across the grid.
Places whole chords or scale patterns from a menu with one click.
rows.notes: One-click root-position chord and single-octave scale patterns preview and place atomically with key/tick bounds, selection and stale-lane/project guards. Combined focused tests, lint and build pass. Independent review reproduced pending-menu cancellation and outside-grid modifier-preview bugs; repairs are in progress. See docs/PIANO-SCALES.md.

rows.fl_feature: Piano roll: preview keyboard and key labels
rows.summary: The on-screen keyboard at the left edge previews pitches when clicked and can carry custom key names.

rows.fl_feature: Piano roll: event editor lane and note properties
rows.summary: A lower lane and dialog for editing per-note velocity, pan, pitch and modulation values.
rows.notes: Velocity and pan lanes. Other note properties are not in the model yet.

rows.fl_feature: Piano roll: slide and portamento notes
rows.summary: Notes that bend an already playing note to a new pitch, and a per-note glide switch.

rows.fl_feature: Piano roll: note colors (16 color groups)
rows.summary: Tags notes with one of 16 colors that double as MIDI channels for routing and selection.
Shows notes from the other channels in the pattern as faint references that can be made editable.

rows.fl_feature: Piano roll: scale highlighting and snap to scale
rows.summary: Shades the grid for a chosen key and scale and can hold notes to it.
rows.notes: Validated root/scale preferences, opt-in row highlighting and deterministic pitch snap are implemented. Group moves preserve intervals through a documented anchor policy; enabling guidance leaves existing notes unchanged. Combined focused tests, lint and build pass; independent review found no actionable scale/snap issue. See docs/PIANO-SCALES.md.

rows.summary: Sets the grid resolution that notes and edits align to.

rows.fl_feature: Piano roll: time markers and per-pattern time signatures
rows.summary: Labels positions inside a pattern and lets a pattern carry its own time signatures.
Shows an audio waveform behind the grid as a timing reference.
Moves note starts and ends toward the grid or a groove template.
rows.notes: Selected-note starts/ends now quantize to grid or original repeating grooves with adjustable strength through one atomic Rust command. Native, real-WASM, UI, undo/redo and persistence checks pass. See docs/PIANO-TOOLS.md. Three independent piano/transport review rounds are closed after document-reply repairs; combined UI tests pass. See docs/DOCUMENT-REPLIES.md.

rows.fl_feature: Piano roll: Articulator tool and Quick legato
rows.summary: Changes note lengths in bulk to give legato, staccato or portamento phrasing.
rows.notes: Selected-note legato and staccato length transformations are implemented with atomic undo and stale-review guards. Portamento phrasing remains pending. See docs/PIANO-TOOLS.md.

rows.fl_feature: Piano roll: Chopper tool and Quick chop
rows.summary: Cuts long notes into shorter pieces by grid or by a slicing pattern.
rows.notes: Selected notes split at absolute grid boundaries with bounded output, one undo entry, and recovered selection after missed events. Independent review of this workflow is closed; user-authored slicing patterns remain unfinished. See docs/PIANO-TOOLS.md and docs/DOCUMENT-REPLIES.md.

rows.summary: Joins touching notes into one.
rows.notes: Touching/overlapping selected notes with matching pitch, velocity and pan union deterministically; incompatible and unselected notes remain separate. See docs/PIANO-TOOLS.md. Three independent piano/transport review rounds are closed after document-reply repairs; combined UI tests pass. See docs/DOCUMENT-REPLIES.md.

rows.summary: Rewrites selected chords as arpeggio patterns.
Staggers the timing and velocity of the notes in a chord like a strummed instrument.
rows.notes: Selected simultaneous chords stagger timing and velocity in either pitch order, preserving lengths and unrelated properties in one undo step. See docs/PIANO-TOOLS.md. Three independent piano/transport review rounds are closed after document-reply repairs; combined UI tests pass. See docs/DOCUMENT-REPLIES.md.

rows.summary: Adds a close double hit to selected notes for a drum flam.
Removes, adds or shifts notes at intervals to turn a regular rhythm into a new one.
Transposes notes so they fall inside a chosen key range.
rows.notes: Selected notes transpose and clamp or fold by octaves into a chosen MIDI-key range. Native, real-WASM, UI and persistence checks pass. See docs/PIANO-TOOLS.md. Three independent piano/transport review rounds are closed after document-reply repairs; combined UI tests pass. See docs/DOCUMENT-REPLIES.md.

rows.summary: Mirrors selected notes in time or in pitch.
rows.notes: Selected notes mirror in time or pitch with atomic undo, native/shared-WASM parity and persistence tests. See docs/PIANO-TOOLS.md. Three independent piano/transport review rounds are closed after document-reply repairs; combined UI tests pass. See docs/DOCUMENT-REPLIES.md.

rows.summary: Generates random notes from a chord map and randomizes pan, velocity and pitch.
Rescales the velocities of selected notes while keeping their relative differences.
rows.notes: Selected velocities scale while retaining relative differences until clipping at full velocity. Other note properties are preserved. See docs/PIANO-TOOLS.md. Three independent piano/transport review rounds are closed after document-reply repairs; combined UI tests pass. See docs/DOCUMENT-REPLIES.md.

rows.summary: Writes an LFO shape into the event lane as automation data.
Generates melodies in stages from progression, arpeggio and level settings.
rows.notes: Not named in the plan's phase table, so placed in phase 6.

rows.summary: Runs Python scripts that create or transform notes in the piano roll.
rows.notes: Part of the plan's phase-6 scripting.

rows.fl_feature: Piano roll: export as score sheet
rows.summary: Exports the piano roll as printable staff notation.
rows.notes: Not named in the plan's phase table, so placed in phase 6.

rows.summary: Instances of a pattern placed on the timeline; editing the pattern updates every instance.
Places one clip per click and moves or resizes clips.
Repeats the selected clip along a track while dragging.
Removes clips by clicking or dragging over them.
Silences individual clips without removing them.
Slides a clip's content left or right inside its fixed start and end.
Cuts clips along a drawn line.
rows.notes: One selected audio clip can be split at reviewed grid/transient markers into source-linked clips in one undo step, retaining trim/reverse/tape pitch/routing. Drawn-line slicing across clip types remains pending. See docs/SLICER.md.

rows.summary: Selects clips or a time range by dragging.
Zooms the view to a dragged region.
Starts or scrubs playback from the clicked position.

rows.fl_feature: Playlist tracks (name, color, mute, solo, resize)
rows.summary: Horizontal lanes that hold any clip type and can be named, colored, resized, muted and soloed.
rows.notes: Name, mute and reordering. No color, solo or per-track resize yet.

rows.summary: Nests tracks under a parent so they collapse, mute and solo together.

rows.fl_feature: Playlist: instrument tracks and audio tracks
rows.summary: Links a timeline track to a channel and a mixer track so it behaves like a track in a conventional DAW.
Named points on the timeline that label sections and can loop, skip or pause playback.
Keeps several alternative timeline layouts inside one project.

rows.fl_feature: Playlist: clip source menu and picker panel
rows.summary: A list of every pattern, audio clip and automation clip for choosing what to place next.
rows.notes: Patterns, audio and automations can each be picked as the brush.

rows.summary: Groups clips so that selecting, moving or deleting one affects them all.
Turns one clip instance into an independent copy so it can be edited without changing the others.
Sets the grid that clips move and resize to.

rows.fl_feature: Playlist: timeline selection and loop region
rows.summary: A highlighted time range that sets the loop for playback and the range for export.

rows.fl_feature: Playlist: audio clip fades, crossfades and gain handles
rows.summary: On-clip handles for fade-in, fade-out and gain, with crossfades between overlapping clips.
rows.notes: Fade in, fade out and gain handles. No automatic crossfades yet.

rows.fl_feature: Playlist: audio clip properties (gain, pan, pitch, reverse, normalize)
rows.summary: Per-instance settings for an audio clip's gain, pan, pitch, direction and normalization.
rows.notes: Per-instance gain, pan, tape/spectral pitch, reverse, fades and independent playlist stretch are implemented. Native audio-editor normalization creates a unique derived WAV with undo; a direct non-destructive normalize property remains pending. See docs/AUDIO-EDITOR.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

rows.fl_feature: Playlist: automation clip editing (curve shapes, step mode, LFO mode)
rows.summary: Control points with adjustable curves, freehand step drawing and an LFO generator inside the clip.
rows.notes: Points, bends and holds are edited in the clip. No LFO mode or multi-point selection yet.

rows.summary: A separate editor for automation stored as events inside a pattern instead of as a clip.

rows.fl_feature: Playlist: audio clip stretch and pitch-shift
rows.summary: Stretches a clip to a new length or pitch on the timeline.
rows.notes: Playlist inspector offers independent spectral duration/pitch, quality and approximate formants alongside default tape playback. DSP prepares off session/audio threads, with bounded cached immutable buffers, trim/fade/reverse handling and undo/save support. Playback/export match exactly; callback allocation tests cover loops, seeks and plan changes. Sampler integration remains separate. See crates/windfall-stretch/VALIDATION.md.

rows.fl_feature: Playlist: detect tempo and fit to tempo
rows.summary: Estimates a sample's tempo and stretches it to match the project.
rows.notes: Playlist inspector detects tempo candidates and fits clips using a chosen/manual source BPM or beat count. Half/double-beat ambiguity and empty results are reported; scores are not probabilities. Fit applies independent spectral stretch as one undo step, adjusting trims/length/fades. Fitting does not follow later project tempo changes automatically.

rows.summary: Renders the pattern and audio clips on selected tracks to a new audio clip and mutes the sources.
Reduces the reverb in an audio clip with a trained model, with general and vocal modes.
rows.notes: Machine-learning feature not named in the plan; no candidate basis identified.

rows.fl_feature: Mixer: insert tracks, master track and current track
rows.summary: Insert tracks for incoming audio, a master track, and a utility track that follows the selection.
rows.notes: FL has 500 insert tracks, one master and one current track.

rows.fl_feature: Mixer: track fader, pan, mute and solo
rows.summary: Level fader, pan knob and mute/solo switch on every track.
A live peak level meter on every track.
rows.notes: The phase-0 spike already shows live meters.

rows.summary: Each track holds up to ten effects in series, each with an on/off switch and a mix level.

rows.fl_feature: Mixer: track routing and send levels
rows.summary: Any track can feed any other track, with a level knob per connection.
Sends a track's audio to another track's plugins as a control input without it being heard there.
A small parametric equalizer built into every track after its effect slots.

rows.fl_feature: Mixer: phase invert, swap left/right and stereo separation
rows.summary: Per-track switches and a knob for polarity, channel swap and stereo width.

rows.fl_feature: Mixer: plugin delay compensation (automatic and manual)
rows.summary: Delays tracks to line up with those whose plugins add latency, automatically or by a typed offset.
rows.notes: Automatic compensation across the whole routing graph. No manual offset yet.

rows.fl_feature: Mixer: track docks and layout views
rows.summary: Left, middle and right docks for tracks and eight size layouts from compact to extra large.
Saves and reloads a track's effects and settings as a preset.
Swaps the level meters for scrolling waveforms.
Selects several tracks at once so they can be routed, moved or adjusted together.

rows.fl_feature: Mixer: external audio input and output per track
rows.summary: Chooses which sound card input feeds a track and which output it plays through.

rows.fl_feature: Mixer: track record arm and disk recording
rows.summary: Arms tracks so their audio is recorded to files.

rows.fl_feature: Mixer: render tracks to wave files
rows.summary: Renders the armed or selected mixer tracks to audio files offline.
A side panel listing user-chosen folders of samples, presets and projects.
Plays a sample when it is clicked in the list.
Shows the waveform of a sample in the browser, optionally inline in the list.
rows.notes: Inline waveforms were added in FL Studio 2026.

rows.summary: Finds files by name across the browser folders, with wildcards and boolean terms.
rows.notes: Recursive native indexing and shared Rust filename/path wildcard/Boolean queries are integrated with bounded scans, cancellation and checked imports. Independent integration review is pending. See docs/BROWSER-LIBRARY.md.

rows.summary: Drags samples, presets and plugins from the browser onto the rack, timeline or mixer.
Lists autosaved, dated backup copies of projects.
User-defined labels on files for filtering the list.
rows.notes: Normalized per-file tags persist atomically in separate local metadata and combine with query/favorite filters. Corrupt metadata is preserved and reported. Independent integration review is pending. See docs/BROWSER-LIBRARY.md.

rows.summary: Marks favorite files and shows them in their own tab.
rows.notes: Per-file favorites persist across restart and root removal; the Starred filtered view combines with queries and tags. Native/mock/UI checks pass; independent integration review is pending. See docs/BROWSER-LIBRARY.md.

rows.summary: Lists everything in the open project: patterns, instruments, effects, samples, controller links and edit history.
A full-screen overview of the project's clips and channels and how they relate.
A browsable catalog of installed and favorite plugins and their presets.
A full-screen grid of plugin thumbnails for adding one by drag or double-click.

rows.fl_feature: Browser: Library and Sounds tabs (FL Cloud content)
rows.summary: Tabs that browse and download Image-Line's online samples, loops and presets.
rows.reason: These tabs deliver Image-Line's own samples, loops and presets, some of them paid, which can never be shipped. Windfall's browser indexes the user's folders and Windfall's own CC0 content instead.

rows.summary: A drum machine with 16 physically modeled drum pads.
An additive synth that can also resynthesize audio and images.
An expanded take on a pair of classic analog polysynths.
rows.notes: Candidate basis: Surge XT (GPL-3.0).

rows.summary: An additive synth that morphs between harmonic snapshots.
An additive synth aimed at metallic and shimmering timbres.
A compact subtractive synth designed for quick programming.
rows.notes: Candidate basis: Surge XT (GPL-3.0).

rows.summary: A physical-modeling synth for string instruments.
A subtractive synth modeled on vintage analog hardware.
rows.notes: Candidate basis: Surge XT (GPL-3.0).

rows.summary: A hybrid synth combining FM and subtractive synthesis with a built-in sequencer and effects.
rows.notes: Candidate basis: Dexed (GPL-3.0).

rows.summary: A bass-line synth in the style of a classic acid bass machine, with its own step sequencer.
rows.notes: Candidate basis: Surge XT (GPL-3.0).

rows.summary: A multisample sampler with zone mapping, layering, modulation and effects.
An additive engine presented with subtractive-style controls.
An emulation of a classic analog polysynth.
rows.notes: Candidate basis: Surge XT (GPL-3.0).

rows.summary: Slices drum loops with beat detection and lets each slice be edited, played and rearranged.
Loads and plays SoundFont (.sf2) instrument banks.
A synth combining FM, ring modulation and subtractive methods with a deep modulation matrix.
rows.notes: Candidate basis: Dexed (GPL-3.0).

rows.summary: A simple three-oscillator subtractive synth.
rows.notes: The plan's phase-2 subtractive synth.

rows.summary: A preset-only synth that derives a patch from a preset number, giving billions of variations.
A kick drum synth with an optional sample layer.
Turns an image into sound by scanning it and mapping color and brightness to frequency and level.
A simple monophonic bass guitar instrument with tone controls.
The basic one-sample channel with pitch, envelope, loop and stretch settings.
rows.notes: The plan's phase-1 sampler. One-shot and gated playback, tuning, trim, reverse, volume envelope, cut groups, persisted forward/ping-pong loops and editable loop points. Filter and independent sampler time-stretch remain unfinished; see docs/SAMPLER-LOOPS.md.

rows.summary: A playback-only version of the multisample sampler for loading ready-made instruments.
A single physically modeled drum per channel, built for use with the step sequencer.
A preset-driven synth with macro controls, built on subtractive, wavetable, multisample and FM engines.
rows.notes: Its preset packs are Image-Line content; a Windfall equivalent needs its own. Candidate basis: Vital or Surge XT (GPL-3.0).

rows.summary: A drum synth holding many programmable patches, one per key.
A light eight-voice FM synth.
rows.notes: Candidate basis: Dexed (GPL-3.0).

rows.summary: A granular sampler that plays a sample as many small overlapping grains.
A simple kick drum synth built from a pitch-swept sine wave.
rows.notes: The manual calls it Fruit Kick.

rows.summary: A pad-based drum sampler with layered samples per pad.
rows.notes: Its bundled kits are Image-Line content; needs own.

rows.summary: Cuts a loop into slices mapped across the keyboard for rearranging.
rows.notes: May share one Windfall plugin with the phase-3 slicer.

rows.summary: Detects beats in a loop and maps the slices to notes for independent triggering.
rows.notes: Shared Rust grid/transient analysis and reviewed linked-source playlist slices provide the detector foundation. Independent note triggering, playable slice mapping and a slicer instrument remain pending. Fades, spectral stretch, swing and tempo-automated projects are explicitly refused. See docs/SLICER.md.

rows.summary: A hybrid synth and effects channel taken from a groove-box instrument.
rows.notes: The manual names it Groove Machine Synth.

rows.summary: A light subtractive synth laid out in tabs, originally from the mobile app.
rows.notes: Candidate basis: Surge XT (GPL-3.0).

rows.summary: Synthesizes plucked strings by modeling a vibrating string.
A three-oscillator analog-style subtractive synth.
rows.notes: Candidate basis: Surge XT (GPL-3.0).

rows.summary: Turns typed text into robotic spoken or sung audio.
rows.notes: Windows only in FL.

rows.summary: Plays a sample along drawn curves to simulate turntable scratching.
A sample-based piano and keyboard instrument with low CPU use.
rows.notes: Its samples are Image-Line content; needs own.

rows.summary: A panel of custom controls for external MIDI hardware or internal targets.
rows.notes: manual-only: listed in the online manual's plugin index, not on the compare-editions page, so outside its 39/71/6 totals. The manual calls it a legacy plugin kept for old projects, superseded by Control Surface.

rows.summary: Plays force-feedback effects on game controllers from notes.
rows.notes: manual-only: listed in the online manual's plugin index, not on the compare-editions page, so outside its 39/71/6 totals. Windows only in FL.

rows.summary: Splits audio into its transient and sustained parts so each can be processed separately.
rows.notes: New in FL Studio 2026.

rows.summary: An algorithmic reverb covering realistic rooms through to pitch-shifted, modulated spaces.
Shifts the pitch and formant of incoming audio in real time, with separate modes for voice and full mixes.
rows.notes: Candidate basis: Signalsmith Stretch (MIT).

rows.summary: Boosts or softens the attack and release portions of a sound.
A multi-stage mastering limiter that raises loudness while keeping dynamics and tonal balance.
Detects transients in incoming audio and uses them to retrigger and reloop it in real time.
Bends the playback position and volume of live audio along drawn curves for stutter, gating and scratch effects.
A rack of eleven guitar pedal effects with cabinet simulation.
Adds harmonics to bass content so low notes stay audible on small speakers.
Corrects pitch in real time and can add harmony voices under MIDI control.
rows.notes: Needs real-time pitch detection.

rows.summary: A chorus modeled on the one built into a classic analog polysynth.
A phaser modeled on a classic analog pedal.
Moves every frequency by a fixed amount in hertz, giving metallic and inharmonic tones.
An extreme multi-voice chorus for supersaw-style thickening.
A mastering dynamics processor that compresses and limits separate frequency bands.
Splits audio into 16 frequency bands with separate delay, level and pan for each.
Widens the stereo image while staying compatible with mono playback.
A many-band vocoder with a built-in carrier synth.
A blank panel for building custom knobs, sliders and buttons that link to other parameters.
A modular distortion unit combining several distortion types, filters, chorus and speaker cabinets.
Twelve performance effects, used one at a time and steered from an X/Y pad.
A graphic equalizer that can morph between stored curve shapes.
Divides audio into two or three frequency bands that can be routed to separate outputs.
A plain volume and pan utility.
rows.notes: Built-in processor, generated controls, automation/history and native/shared-WASM integration are implemented with measured signal, latency and callback-allocation checks. Independent integration review is pending. See docs/UTILITY-EFFECTS.md.

An animated dancing character whose moves are triggered by notes.

rows.summary: A pitch editor that detects the notes in a recording so their pitch and timing can be corrected by hand.

rows.summary: A wave editor and recorder that loads in an effect slot for trimming, cleaning and processing samples.
rows.notes: Native selected-clip waveform/range editor supports trim, extract, normalize, reverse, fades, silence and cut. Immutable derived WAVs, one-step undo, stale/source/recording guards and save/reopen are covered. Effect-slot recording/editor integration, cleanup DSP and advanced tools remain pending. Browser mode explicitly refuses native file edits. See docs/AUDIO-EDITOR.md.

rows.summary: A warp editor that slices audio and moves markers to correct or reshape its timing.
rows.notes: Candidate basis: Signalsmith Stretch (MIT).

rows.summary: Saves the whole project, without its samples, to one native file and reopens it.
rows.notes: Windfall uses its own open format: readable JSON plus audio in a folder or zip, with a version number. Windfall saves its own readable JSON format, .windfall. Reading .flp files is a separate row.

rows.summary: Packs the project together with the samples it uses into one archive.
rows.notes: Native bounded schema-1 ZIP export/open includes captured project/session/plugin state and exact-deduplicated audio. Validated staged extraction, missing-source reports, cancellation and no-overwrite publication are implemented. Independent combined review is pending. See docs/PORTABLE-PROJECTS.md.

rows.summary: Saves the project under the next numbered file name.
rows.notes: Native numbered saves atomically publish the next unused filename through existing plugin capture/sample-carry flow. Earlier versions stay intact and concurrent edits remain dirty. Focused native/UI checks pass; independent integration review is pending. See docs/PORTABLE-PROJECTS.md.

rows.summary: Writes backup copies of the project automatically.
rows.notes: The plan builds autosave and timestamped backups into the project format.

rows.fl_feature: New from template and Save as template
rows.summary: Starts a project from a stored template and saves the current project as one.
rows.notes: FL's bundled templates reference Image-Line content; needs own.

rows.fl_feature: FL Studio project (.flp) as an import source
rows.summary: Reads notes, clips, automation, routing and sample references out of an FL project file.
rows.notes: Desktop picker prepares a reviewed conversion with category reports, bounded sample searches, missing-audio warnings, unsaved-project confirmation and stale-request guards. Unsupported plugin bytes and metadata persist in .windfall files and an Imported sounds report. Two real FL 20.8.4 reader projects verified; other versions remain unverified. Sound mappings and some timing/automation are approximate; proprietary restoration and identical playback remain unavailable. See docs/flp/coverage.md.

rows.summary: Uploads a zipped copy of the project to online storage when it is saved.
rows.notes: New in FL Studio 2026. The plan lists optional cloud backup in phase 6.

rows.summary: Stores the settings of a channel, plugin or mixer track as a preset file.
rows.notes: Windfall presets use its own format; FL's bundled presets cannot be shipped.

rows.summary: Saves and loads a piano roll's notes and events as a reusable file.
rows.notes: FL 2026 treats .mid and .fsc interchangeably for scores.

rows.summary: Loads uncompressed WAV audio into samplers and audio clips.
Loads MP3 audio into samplers and audio clips.
rows.notes: Native picker and browser support MP3; the shared sample loader supplies preview, sampler channels and playlist clips. Headless session tests verify exact gapless duration, playback, one-step undo, save/reopen and corrupt-file rejection.

rows.summary: Loads Ogg Vorbis audio into samplers and audio clips.
rows.notes: Native picker and browser support OGG; the shared sample loader supplies preview, sampler channels and playlist clips. Headless session tests verify exact gapless duration, playback, one-step undo, save/reopen and corrupt-file rejection.

rows.summary: Loads FLAC audio into samplers and audio clips.
rows.notes: Native picker and browser support FLAC; the shared sample loader supplies preview, sampler channels and playlist clips. Headless session tests verify exact gapless duration, playback, one-step undo, save/reopen and corrupt-file rejection.

rows.summary: Imports the tracks of a MIDI file into channels, or one track into the open piano roll.
rows.notes: Desktop file picker, review/options and adjustment report append SMF formats 0/1/2 with PPQ/SMPTE as one checked undo step. Optional factory drums, tempo automation, bar splits and shared sections are supported. Unsupported events are reported. Native session and browser tests verify errors, cancellation, stale reviews and undo; the browser uses the same Rust MIDI converter.

rows.summary: Loads sliced loop files, keeping their slice points.
rows.notes: Not in the plan. REX decoding normally relies on a proprietary SDK; check its license against GPL-3.0 (may become wont-do).

rows.fl_feature: Sampler sources: DrumSynth (.ds), SimSynth (.syn) and speech (.speech) presets
rows.summary: Renders small synth or speech preset files into a sampler channel as if they were samples.
rows.notes: Not in the plan; legacy formats.

rows.summary: Opens slice-grid files written by two older beat-slicing tools.
rows.notes: Not in the plan; legacy format.

rows.summary: Renders the song or pattern offline to WAV at 16-bit, 24-bit or 32-bit float.
Renders to MP3 at a chosen bit rate.
rows.notes: Bundled LAME encoder with CBR 128/192/256/320 or VBR quality 0-9, mono/stereo/joint stereo, gapless length and independent ffmpeg verification. Desktop export controls are wired.

rows.summary: Renders to Ogg Vorbis at a chosen bit rate.
rows.notes: Bundled Vorbis encoder with quality -1 to 10, gapless length and independent ffmpeg verification. Desktop export controls are wired.

rows.summary: Renders to lossless compressed FLAC.
rows.notes: Native Rust encoder, 16/24-bit, compression levels 0-8 and deterministic dither. Desktop controls offer fastest, standard and smallest-file presets. Exact samples verified with own decoder and ffmpeg.

rows.summary: Writes the project's step and piano roll notes to a standard MIDI file.
rows.notes: Desktop pattern/song export writes MIDI format 0/1 at 480/960 PPQ with optional running status and swing. Native writes are atomic; the browser downloads bytes from the same Rust exporter. Offsets, loops, mutes and tempo changes are preserved. Audio and sound processing are omitted; excess melodic tracks reuse MIDI channels.

rows.summary: Renders each mixer track to its own audio file in one pass.
rows.notes: Desktop export selects mixer tracks, mix inclusion, numbering and folders in all four audio formats. Track-output stems stream in one pass; source-through-master stems use separate passes, with nonlinear processing documented. Cancellation and ordinary-error rollback are tested.

rows.summary: Renders each timeline track to its own audio file.

rows.fl_feature: Export options (song or pattern, tail, bit depth, dithering, resampling)
rows.summary: Settings for what is rendered, how the tail is handled and the quality of the output.
rows.notes: Song/pattern rendering, pattern repetitions, fixed or automatic tails, sample rate, lossless bit depth, compressed-format quality, stem selection and cancellation are available in the desktop dialog.

rows.summary: Renders to AAC audio in an M4A file.
rows.notes: Not in the plan's export list. AAC encoder licensing must be checked against GPL-3.0.

rows.fl_feature: Export: loop, slice and note markers in WAV files
rows.summary: Embeds loop points and markers from the timeline or notes into rendered WAV files.
rows.notes: Not named in the plan's phase table, so placed in phase 6.

rows.summary: Saves audio as WavPack files from the audio editor.
rows.notes: Not in the plan.

rows.summary: Loads VST3 instruments and effects.
rows.notes: VST3 backend hosts instruments/effects with events, parameters, transport, inactive state and Windows editors. A bounded owner-thread processor-return path now exercises desktop capture/save/export with native fixtures. Production desktop additions remain disabled pending dirty-state scheduling, events during capture and fallible native deactivation. Native macOS/Linux hosting and audio crash containment remain pending. See docs/plugins/vst3-desktop.md and docs/plugins/vst3-hosting.md.

rows.summary: Loads CLAP instruments and effects.
rows.notes: Windows desktop CLAP instruments/effects now integrate project persistence, native-range automation, playback/export, mixer latency compensation, parameter inspectors and native editors. Real CLAP fixtures verify session audio, state round-trip and current-instance ownership. The host backend was also exercised with Surge XT/Effects and OB-Xf. Native macOS/Linux desktop hosting and audio crash containment remain unfinished. See docs/plugins/desktop-integration.md and docs/plugins/host-evaluation.md.

rows.summary: Loads Audio Unit instruments and effects on macOS.
rows.notes: macOS only.

rows.summary: Loads instruments and effects in the older VST2 format.
rows.notes: unverified: licensing path. Not in the plan; Steinberg no longer issues VST2 SDK licenses, so this needs a decision and may become wont-do.

rows.summary: Scans plugin folders, verifies each plugin and sorts it as instrument or effect.
rows.notes: Windows desktop plugin manager provides isolated CLAP/VST3 discovery through the app scanner helper, persisted folders/cache/blocklist, search, scan progress and retry. CLAP entries can be added as rack instruments or mixer effects; VST3 addition explains its active-state capture limitation. Native macOS/Linux manager availability remains pending. Scanner isolation does not contain audio plugin crashes. See docs/plugins/desktop-integration.md.

rows.summary: Runs a plugin in its own process, isolated from the host.
rows.notes: The plan's crash protection.

rows.fl_feature: Plugin wrapper options (smart disable, fixed-size buffers, threaded processing, scaling, detached window)
rows.summary: Per-plugin switches for idle bypass, buffer handling, threading, window scaling and window detachment.

rows.fl_feature: FL Studio as a VST or AU plugin
rows.summary: Runs the whole program as an instrument plugin inside another host, with multiple outputs.
rows.notes: The plan lists this as 'possible later' and assigns no phase.

rows.fl_feature: Audio settings (driver, device, sample rate, buffer length)
rows.summary: Chooses the sound card driver and device and sets sample rate and buffer size.
rows.notes: The plan uses cpal: WASAPI and ASIO on Windows, CoreAudio on macOS, ALSA, JACK and PipeWire on Linux. Device, sample rate and buffer through WASAPI, CoreAudio, ALSA and JACK. ASIO is behind a build feature that is off.

rows.fl_feature: Transport (play, stop, record, pattern/song mode, song position)

Initial capture uses manual playlist placement without hardware latency/clock compensation; monitoring, count-in and multitrack takes remain.

rows.summary: Sets the project tempo by typing, dragging or tapping.

rows.summary: Plays a click on each beat.

rows.summary: Steps back and forward through edits, with the stored actions listed in the project browser.
